title: vivo launches the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India on Thu 26 Nov 2026 at 12 PM IST (confirmed by vivo India, 12 Nov); Pro Max: 7,800mAh typical (7,605mAh rated) battery, 200MP ZEISS APO telephoto (85 mm, 15 cm macro), 6.85-inch; Pro: 6,510mAh typical, 64MP telephoto, 6.36-inch; Dimensity 9600 Pro; 90W wired, 40W wireless with a vivo/iQOO wireless charger; 400 mm ZEISS extender for the Pro Max sold separately; India prices not announced; last year's X300 Pro launched in India on 2 Dec 2025 at ₹1,09,999 (X300 from ₹75,999)
